articles._summary: June’s inflation report delivered a pleasant surprise, with the annual CPI rate falling to 3.5%. The data was released just hours before new Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s first congressional testimony, giving investors fresh insight into how the Fed’s policy outlook could evolve from here. Strip out food and energy, and there was zero inflation last month. That’s the number that matters most for what happens next. One day before this report, Fed Governor Waller warned that a hot core print could force the FOMC to consider hiking. Well, the report came in flat instead, meaning that the hawkish case is now effectively off the table. The flat core print is the first genuinely clean signal in months that underlying price pressures are breaking, rather than just easing on the back of temporary swings in energy costs.
articles._zh_headline: 6 月 CPI 报告刚刚改变了利率争论：投资者应该关注以下内容
articles._zh_summary: 6月通胀报告令人惊喜，CPI年率回落至3.5%。该数据是在美联储新任主席凯文·沃什首次在国会作证前几个小时发布的，让投资者对美联储的政策前景如何演变有了新的了解。除去食品和能源，上个月通胀为零。这是对接下来发生的事情最重要的数字。在这份报告发布前一天，美联储理事沃勒警告称，一份热门的核心报告可能会迫使联邦公开市场委员会考虑加息。然而，该报告的结果却持平，这意味着鹰派的观点现在实际上已经不被讨论了。扁平核心打印是几个月来第一个真正明确的信号，表明潜在的价格压力正在突破，而不仅仅是因能源成本暂时波动而缓解。

articles.author: Chandrima Sanyal
articles.headline: IBM Says AI Spending Isn't Crowding Out Cybersecurity. These ETFs Are Gaining Momentum
articles.summary: IBM says enterprises are prioritizing cybersecurity alongside AI infrastructure. Cybersecurity ETFs celebrate.
articles._summary: The catalyst came from IBM’s latest earnings commentary. CEO Arvind Krishna said enterprise customers shifted capital spending toward servers, storage and memory to secure supply-constrained AI infrastructure ahead of expected price increases. At the same time, he said “rapidly evolving, industry-wide cybersecurity concerns” remained a key area of customer focus. The remarks reassured investors that cybersecurity is proving resilient even as companies devote billions of dollars to building AI infrastructure.
articles._zh_headline: IBM 表示人工智能支出并没有取代网络安全。这些 ETF 势头强劲
articles._zh_summary: 催化剂来自 IBM 最新的财报评论。首席执行官 Arvind Krishna 表示，企业客户将资本支出转向服务器、存储和内存，以在预期价格上涨之前确保供应有限的人工智能基础设施。与此同时，他表示“快速发展的全行业网络安全问题”仍然是客户关注的关键领域。这些言论让投资者放心，即使公司投入数十亿美元建设人工智能基础设施，网络安全也被证明具有弹性。

articles.author: Chandrima Sanyal
articles.headline: The Secret Behind 2026's Biggest ETF Launches Isn't What You Think
articles.summary: A record 728 ETFs launched in H1 2026, but only a handful captured billions. Here's what these standout funds reveal about where ETF innovation is headed.
articles._summary: According to CFRA Research , the standout launches of 2026 show ETF issuers are increasingly building products around structural shifts—from AI infrastructure and commercial space to stablecoin regulation and niche credit markets—instead of broad market benchmarks. No launch illustrates that better than the Roundhill Memory ETF (BATS: DRAM ) . The Tema Space Innovators ETF (NASDAQ: NASA ) gathered $1.37 billion by giving investors pre-IPO exposure to SpaceX through a special purpose vehicle.
articles._zh_headline: 2026 年最大规模 ETF 推出背后的秘密并非如您所想
articles._zh_summary: CFRA Research 表示，2026 年推出的出色产品表明 ETF 发行人越来越多地围绕结构性转变（从人工智能基础设施和商业空间到稳定币监管和利基信贷市场）打造产品，而不是广泛的市场基准。没有任何发布比 Roundhill Memory ETF (BATS: DRAM) 更能说明这一点。 Tema Space Innovators ETF（纳斯达克股票代码：NASA）通过特殊目的工具向投资者提供 SpaceX 首次公开募股前投资，募集了 13.7 亿美元资金。

articles.summary: Schmid stock is moving higher in Tuesday's after-hours session after the company provided an order guidance update for 2026.
articles._summary: Due to sustained improvement in order momentum, Schmid raised its full-year 2026 order intake guidance from approximately 114 million euros ($130.2 million) to a new range of 125 million euros to 130 million euros. The company said it booked 30.7 million euros in new orders and reported revenue of 27.7 million euros for the second quarter of 2026. With the repeat order of more than 37 million euros announced on July 7, year-to-date order intake reached 81.6 million euros.
